programme: ShotSight Virtual Shooter — Learn to Shoot

latest_verified_ci.note: Full L0->L3 regression green including Human Vision pull-away reward support and first hit/miss memory-learning gate. Binary reward support exists but is sparse/population-sensitive; the first one-dimensional UCB1 memory produced no positive development-held-out learning signal.

governing_rule: ORACLE KNOWS. SHOOTER PERCEIVES, BELIEVES, PLANS, ACTS, REMEMBERS AND LEARNS.
shooting_axiom: GOOD SHOOTING IS CONTINUOUS PERCEPTUAL COUPLING BETWEEN TARGET AND GUN: READ THE LINE -> MATCH THE SPEED -> APPLY THE METHOD -> TRIGGER -> FOLLOW THROUGH.
anti_cheat_audit_status: GREEN_THROUGH_L3_PULL_AWAY_HUMAN_VISION_HIT_MISS_LEARNING_AT_CI_33985663294; LEARNER MEMORY IMPORTS NO ORACLE/PHYSICS/REFEREE; HELDOUT UNUSED FOR POLICY SELECTION; ORACLE SCORES POST_TRIGGER_ONLY; TARGET_SEED_SCENARIO_SEED_MISS_DISTANCE_TRUE_RANGE_FUTURE_PATH_INTERCEPT_PELLET_TOF_REQUIRED_LEAD_AND_DIRECT_CORRECTION REMAIN OUTSIDE LEARNER POLICY AND MEMORY
active_hypotheses: Good shooting is continuous perceptual coupling: read the live line, match gun speed, apply method, trigger, and follow through.
Human-analogous acquisition creates an information-versus-runway trade-off: waiting may improve line/speed belief but consumes shooting opportunity.
Pull-away remains the primary L3 method because acquire/connect/match/separate/trigger/follow-through gives an interpretable adaptation loop.
Sparse binary reward support under Human Vision may be too population-sensitive for a context-free one-dimensional memory; establish replication before enriching memory or scaling compute.
Ellis apprenticeship records are learner-safe context that may later support episodic/contextual memory if reward support proves reproducible.
Satisfaction and affect-like variables remain experimental and must survive explicit ablation before retention.
negative_findings: Static one-dimensional maintained-lead separation had no binary reward support after expanded diagnosis; motor travel was not the primary limitation.
Shooter-visible trigger timing expansion produced 100 physical follow-through shots across 1512 attempts and zero proxy hits.
Fresh post-geometry diagnostic produced 0/660 hits; quasi-continuous constant relationship exploration produced 0/1024 hits.
Phase-dependent relationship representation did not outperform constant control: 4/1024 versus 5/1024 proxy hits on the same bank.
Human Vision pull-away reward support was sparse and population-sensitive: 4/1098 overall, all four hits in calibration, with zero in train and development-heldout populations.
The first context-free one-dimensional pull-away UCB1 hit/miss memory failed held-out transfer: learned 0/3 versus no-memory uniform 1/183; memory advantage -0.00546448087431694.

Do not widen the hit proxy, inject referee miss gradients, expose oracle lead, seed learner memory from rewarded action identities, or treat the 55 mm engineering proxy as real-world break probability.
Human Vision V1 numerical defaults and pull-away policy thresholds remain SHOTSIGHT_HYPOTHESIS / PROVISIONAL_METHOD_KINEMATICS pending human calibration.
next_action: Run the new four-block Human Vision pull-away binary reward-support replication gate on seed bases 401000-404000 using the unchanged 61-point learner-safe visual-separation grid. Preserve either outcome. If support occurs on multiple fresh blocks, proceed to learner-safe episodic/contextual memory experiments with the current one-dimensional UCB1 learner as a negative baseline. If support remains isolated/absent, diagnose reward landscape, trigger opportunity, presentation context and learner-safe representation before adding memory complexity or compute. Do not scale to 100k until reproducible held-out learning is demonstrated.
